europe_now.title: Belgian Government Crisis
europe_now.summary: Belgian budget talks have failed, leaving the government facing a potential collapse. De Wever is poised to offer his resignation as a result of the political deadlock.

sources.headline: De Wever poised to offer his resignation as Belgian budget talks fail

europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict and Infrastructure Strikes
europe_now.summary: Russia and Ukraine have traded blame regarding cyber attacks and the hacking of emergency alert applications. Meanwhile, a fragile localized ceasefire in the Kherson region has ended amidst ongoing infrastructure strikes.

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Infrastructure and Ceasefire Developments
top_stories.summary: Russian strikes have left thousands of people without power across Ukraine. Additionally, evacuations during the first humanitarian truce in the Kherson region have concluded.
